title: QA.tech MCP
lede: QA.tech MCP lets a coding agent in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex hand testing to an outside QA agent that explores the app, writes end-to-end tests and reports what broke.

points: Works with any MCP client; the team names Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
QA.tech maps the app, writes tests and runs them in a real browser against a preview or staging URL.
Failures go back to the coding agent with the cause, so it can fix and rerun before the PR reaches review.
Setup is a single prompt, and everything in the QA.tech product is also exposed over MCP.

sections.text: Developers working with coding agents who otherwise click through the app themselves to check that a task the agent called done actually works.
Usage is credit-based; the launch comment offers Product Hunt users 50 extra credits, about a month of use, with code PHMCP until 9 December.
